core_problem_solved: To provide a set of low-level, foundational components for the HTTP and HTTPS protocols, serving as the core I/O engine for the Apache HttpComponents library.
key_features: A low-level I/O processing model for handling HTTP transport
Foundational classes for managing HTTP connections and pipelines
era_and_niche: A core, low-level module for the modern Apache HttpComponents project. It is a foundational library, not typically used directly by application developers, but serves as the base for `httpclient`.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** and is actively maintained as the core of the HttpComponents project. It is almost always used as a transitive dependency brought in by the higher-level and user-facing **`org.apache.httpcomponents:httpclient`** library. You would rarely declare a direct dependency on `httpcore`.
